attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Removing the early-return for empty indexSettings could allow subsequent code (e.g., SelectMany/GroupBy over content types, or deleting/updating index tasks) to execute unnecessarily when there are no index settings, potentially causing null-index update attempts or unintended task processing across all tenants using Azure AI Search."}

reason: Removing the early-return for empty indexSettings could allow subsequent code (e.g., SelectMany/GroupBy over content types, or deleting/updating index tasks) to execute unnecessarily when there are no index settings, potentially causing null-index update attempts or unintended task processing across all tenants using Azure AI Search.
